text: Painting names: one name per painting, editable by authors and admins
description: New role "author" (USERS entry name:password:author) = rate + name permissions; admins can name too. One name per painting (no suggestion voting). Set during capture (title field, exists) or edited in the rating overlay by authors/admins. Empty → "Untitled". Caveat: capture sync must not overwrite a name edited online (sync currently re-posts title on upsert — only set title on insert).

status.comment: Commit 1e97e54: role author (name:pw:author); PUT /api/rate/paintings/:id/title (author/admin); name field in rating overlay + admin table; capture upsert sets title only on insert. Verified locally: renamed online, re-synced, name kept. Not deployed yet.
